title: Virtus vs Slavia: real cost over 5 years

youtube_title: Virtus vs Slavia: which is cheaper to own over 5 years?
caption:
Virtus or Slavia: which one really costs less over 5 years? 🚗

Same 1.0 TSI engine, same mileage, same service cost. The only real difference is the price you pay on day one.

Base Virtus (Comfortline 1.0 TSI MT): about Rs 13.2 lakh on-road, Rs 17.4 lakh over 5 years.
Base Slavia (Classic 1.0 TSI MT): about Rs 11.9 lakh on-road, Rs 16.1 lakh over 5 years.

That's about Rs 2,200 a month less for the Slavia.

Estimate for Hyderabad: 30 km a day, 20% down payment, 5-year loan at 9%, after resale value. Your city and variant will change the numbers.

Which one would you pick? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇

voice_lines: Virtus versus Slavia. Which one really costs less?
Round one, the engine. Both have the same one litre TSI, so fuel and service cost the same. It's a tie.
Round two, the price. A base Virtus is about thirteen point two lakh on-road in Hyderabad. The Slavia, eleven point nine. Slavia takes it.
Round three, resale. After five years the Virtus sells for about thirty two thousand more. Point to Virtus.
Round four, the total. Loan interest, insurance, fuel, service and tyres, minus resale. Virtus, seventeen point four lakh. Slavia, sixteen point one.
Slavia wins, two to one. About two thousand two hundred rupees a month less. Which one would you pick? Comment below.
